name: rc3
label: rare_chars
note: rare_chars, two tiers in one pass (runs/explore/rc3_report.md, dev only): rules without "tier" form the strict tier (per-corpus FPR cap 0.1%); "tier": "monitor" rules are added on top for the monitoring tier (cap 0.5%). Selected by explore/rc3_search.py (ATOMS=rc3 NEW=none GBFORM=gap GB=runs/explore/rc3_gb_dev_q0.02.npz DROP=gr,rctx,lctx,iso,sandwich,nx1,nxmin,near,punct_in_word,digit_in_word,ecls,fse MAX_RULES=4 MON_RULES=2), prompt-grouped 5-fold CV, on the labels pinned in dataset/corpora.py. lp1 / lpc: log10 of the top-1 / generated token's probability; gap = lp1 - lpc; gb: learned token score (explore/rc3_gb.py, detector/rare_gb.py; its inputs include the reference tables of detector/rare_ref.py), it looks one token ahead, so every alert of this config is raised one token after the triggering token.
